name: stepanov_count
summary: Choose a lift x̃ of each of the q residue classes; the polynomials (X − ι(x̃))^E are pairwise coprime (differences of distinct lifts are units), so their product, monic of degree E·q, divides Φ ≠ 0.

steps.claim: If the residue field is infinite, Nat.card = 0 and the claim is trivial; otherwise it is finite with a Fintype structure, and the claim is E·|κ| ≤ deg Φ.

Let x̃ be a lift (surjInv of the residue map) of each residue class. For distinct classes the difference of the lifts is a unit (its residue is nonzero), so ι of it is a unit and the polynomials (X − ι(x̃))^E are pairwise coprime; each divides Φ (h, via the Taylor shift); hence their product divides Φ. It is monic of degree E·|κ|, and a nonzero polynomial is not divisible by a monic polynomial of larger degree.
steps.lean:
simpa [Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne h0, Monic.natDegree_pow, monic_prod_X_sub_C, Finset.prod_pow,
    Monic.pow] using (Monic.not_dvd_of_natDegree_lt · h0 · (Fintype.prod_dvd_of_coprime
    (fun x y h ↦ .pow (isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (map_sub ι .. ▸ .map ι (by simpa
    [← residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit, surjInv_eq]))))
    (X_sub_C_pow_dvd_iff.2 <| h <| surjInv residue_surjective ·)))
